clips.title: The story
paras: In Thelsamar, Jern Hornhelm keeps the Explorers' League's work moving. The dwarven miner coordinates supplies and messages between the town, Ironforge, and the dig site deeper in Loch Modan. Travelers carry mining supplies and progress reports across the region for him.

Jern Hornhelm works from Thelsamar to keep supplies moving to Loch Modan's dig sites. Dwarven scholars and field teams search the wilderness for their ancestral past, and they need steady deliveries of resources and tools. Jern also makes sure communications reach the active digs.

Jern Hornhelm links field archaeologists with the Explorers' League leadership in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. Ironband's Excavation depends on blasting powder, equipment, and regular dispatches to keep work moving. Jern asks trusted travelers to carry supplies and reports along the trogg-infested roads so the dig can continue.
